title: [3.13] gh-151471: Colorize the soft keyword `type` in IDLE (GH-151700)
body:
`type` is now colored as a keyword when it starts a statement and is followed by a name, as in `type Point = tuple[float, float]`. It stays a builtin elsewhere, for example in `type = type(1)`, `type(x)` or `type in (int, str)`.

(cherry picked from commit 68ed7a50226)

Manual backport: `test_recolorize_main` asserts tags at absolute line numbers, and the colorizer colorizes in chunks whose size doubles, so which chunk a line falls into depends on how many lines precede it. This branch has one line fewer in the test source, and the new `type` line ends up in a chunk which starts inside the unterminated string above it. Instead of the two lines there, this adds `test_type_soft_keyword`, which checks the tag ranges of separate snippets.

Co-authored-by: Shixian Li <znsoooo@gmail.com>
